document_title: A Plan, a Study, and No Published Due Date
post_copy:
At 10:00 a.m. on August 5th, a Senate committee in room SR-253 took up five bills. Three carry AI or a chatbot in the title.

The first federal answer to machines that talk to children is a plan and a study.

Duckworth's office says S. 5171 cleared the committee that day with Alaska's Lisa Murkowski as the Republican cosponsor.
The release describes an FTC and CPSC plan and a National Academies study. It names no rule and no ban.
The committee's page publishes no tally.
The bill text returned 403 on August 15th. No due date for the plan or the study is published.

The agenda with every result row blank, both senators in their own words, and the record as sheets stamped READ or 403.

A plan and a study is the normal first move on something nobody has measured. How long does that stay an answer before it becomes a wait?

#AIToySafety #AlaskaDelegation #SenateCommerce

slides.headline: The first federal answer to talking toys is a plan and a study.
Two agencies owe a plan. One academy owes a study.
slides.body: Per Senator Duckworth's release, the Federal Trade Commission and the Consumer Product Safety Commission must give Congress what the release calls a "coordinated, actionable plan" on AI-enabled toy products. The National Academies must run a comprehensive study.
labels: THE RELEASE DESCRIBES NO RULE, NO BAN AND NO STANDARD

slides.headline: The due date is not on the record.
slides.body: The text of S. 5171 returned a 403 on August 15th, so no deadline for the plan or for the study could be read. The committee's own meeting page carries the agenda and no tally for any of the five bills.

slides.headline: Five bills that morning. Three of them AI.
slides.body: The committee met at 10:00 a.m. on August 5th in room SR-253, entering through SR-254. Three Coast Guard nomination lists were on the same agenda. Senator Duckworth's office announced that day that S. 5171 passed.
labels: CHILDREN'S AI TOY SAFETY ACT OF 2026
RESULT ON ALL FIVE ROWS, NO TALLY PUBLISHED

slides.headline: Knives, pills and matches.
slides.body: "discussing sexually explicit content and explaining where to find knives, pills and matches in the home"
labels: SEN. DUCKWORTH'S OFFICE, CITING U.S. PIRG EDUCATION FUND TESTING, DECEMBER 2025
"These AI chatbots were never meant to be used by young children, yet they're being embedded inside toys by the thousands"
THOUSANDS IS THE SENATOR'S WORD AND CARRIES NO CITED COUNT

slides.headline: The Alaskan on the bill is buying knowledge.
slides.body: Murkowski is the Republican cosponsor named in the announcement. Read fairly, the bill buys knowledge and writes no rule, which is the normal opening move for a technology nobody has measured yet. Whether that is enough is the argument.
labels: "It is imperative we equip policymakers and America's families with the knowledge they need to make informed choices about these devices"

slides.headline: A plan is not a rule. A study is not a standard.
Alaska's own record, as one column tells it.
slides.body: House Bill 47 provisions criminalizing AI-generated child sexual abuse material and deepfake harassment became law in June.
labels: House Concurrent Resolution 3 would have created an AI task force. That effort stalled.
Roughly 30 states have passed election-related deepfake disclosure laws.
Some states now require companion chatbots to disclose that they aren't human or therapists.
PER ADN OPINION COLUMN, ROGER KAYE, AUGUST 10TH
THIS DECK MAKES NO CLAIM ABOUT WHAT ALASKA LAW COVERS ON AI TOYS

slides.headline: Five places the record was asked. One answered.
slides.body: Save this for the next time a talking toy shows up in your house.

aftercare: Post Tuesday to Thursday, 8 to 11 a.m. Alaska time. The primary is August 18th, so a Tuesday post lands on election day and a Wednesday post lands the morning after.
Paste the FIRST COMMENT block within 60 seconds of posting. The URLs must stay visible as plain text.
Reply substantively to every comment in the first 60 to 90 minutes. Threaded author replies drive up to 2.4x reach and a dead first hour is rarely recovered.
The one ask on the close is SAVE. Do not add a second ask in the comments.
If a commenter asks by when the plan is due, the honest answer is that no page reachable on August 15th said, and the bill text returned a 403.
Do not state a committee vote margin. None is published.
